scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: Close tracking shot of a bicycle wheel rolling along a quiet Indian residential lane.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: Saurabh pedals toward a party in casual non-black clothes; keep his face consistent.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: Wide view of modest homes, trees, overhead wires, and amber evening light.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: A large house appears on Saurabh’s right behind an old stone wall and railing.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: He slows as he notices an open upper window above the boundary wall.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: Three South Asian women, each with a distinct face, look out in red and black traditional clothes.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: One woman beckons him toward the house while the other two watch curiously.

scene: EXT. QUIET RESIDENTIAL LANE — DUSK
direction: Saurabh rides a few metres on, then turns his head back toward the window.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: From Saurabh’s viewpoint, the three distinct women look down from the open window.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: The railing crosses the view between the women and Saurabh on the road.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: Saurabh wonders whether they can see his face but not his clothes.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: He looks down at the casual outfit he wore to leave for the party.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: A sudden déjà vu crosses his face; he feels he has seen these women before.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: He murmurs, “I feel like I’ve met them before.”

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: He realizes he may have accidentally worn the same clothes again.

scene: EXT. GREAT HOUSE WINDOW AND BOUNDARY WALL — DUSK
direction: Saurabh turns his bicycle around and heads home to change.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: Saurabh wheels his bicycle into his modest home and goes straight to his room.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: He looks at the casual clothes he wore on the ride to the party.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: He lays out black trousers, a plain black T-shirt, a black jacket, and black boots.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: He changes into the black trousers and T-shirt.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: He puts on the black jacket and heavy black boots.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: A mirror shot confirms his all-black outfit and the same face.

scene: INT. SAURABH’S HOME — DUSK
direction: Saurabh leaves home on his bicycle, now dressed in black.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: Saurabh rides back along the same lane in his all-black outfit.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He passes the great house again and continues toward the party route.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He sees an open entrance in a house beside the road and considers it a shortcut.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He leaves his bicycle near the entrance and walks inside.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: A bare concrete hallway stretches ahead; the street entrance fades behind him.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He turns through a doorway, expecting it to lead to the other side.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: The doorway opens into another similar corridor.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: Saurabh tries left and right turns, searching for the road.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He reaches a metal exit door and finds it will not open.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He retraces his steps and returns to a familiar junction.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He recognizes a crack in the wall and realizes he has looped back.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: A warm glow from a small shop-like partition appears down the hall.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He notices it but decides to keep searching without asking for help.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: He tries another corridor and reaches a dead end.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: Saurabh leans against the concrete wall, tired and breathing harder.

scene: EXT. LANE AND INT. SHORTCUT HOUSE — EVENING
direction: Finally he turns toward the shop and knocks politely on its shutter.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: The metal shutter rises, revealing Baribari in her consistent maroon traditional outfit.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: Hold on Baribari’s distinct face as she looks at Saurabh cautiously and asks, “Who are you?”

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: Baribari follows with, “How did you get in here?”

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: Saurabh explains, “I came through the house to take a shortcut, but I’m lost.”

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: He asks, “Could you please open the exit shutter for me?”

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: Baribari studies him, then turns to the exit lock.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: She unlocks the exit shutter and raises it, revealing the way out.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: Saurabh thanks her; they step toward the counter and begin talking.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: He jokes, “That shortcut has more turns than the whole road.” Baribari laughs, impressed.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION AND EXIT HALL — EVENING
direction: Saurabh asks her name; she replies, “Baribari.”

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: Saurabh repeats softly, “Baribari,” and says he has never heard the name before.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: He asks for her surname so he can find her later; Baribari tells him. Do not invent or display it.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: In their conversation, Saurabh learns that Baribari is Muslim; he listens respectfully.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: They exchange phones and type their own numbers directly into each other’s contacts.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: Keep every phone number unreadable; show no map, party invitation, or extra message.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: Baribari invites him to relax at the shop; Saurabh asks her to come to the party instead.

scene: INT. SHOP PARTITION — EVENING
direction: She smiles and agrees; they leave together through the exit.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: Saurabh and Baribari arrive together at a warm, modest house party.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: Saurabh introduces Baribari to his friends by her first name.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: His friends assume she is his girlfriend and say they look good together.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: Baribari and Saurabh smile happily and do not correct the assumption.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: They spend time with the group, comfortable beside each other.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: Later they sit together by a window, sharing a quiet, warm moment.

scene: INT. PARTY HOUSE — NIGHT
direction: The party winds down; they leave together to walk her home.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: Saurabh walks Baribari home along a quiet street after the party.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: Without warning, Baribari suddenly becomes unconscious and begins to fall.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: Saurabh catches her, calls her name, and receives no response.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: He lifts her onto his back and carries her carefully toward her home.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: They reach a small gate with a narrow opening and rough wall.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: He softly tells her to hold on, grips the wall top, and keeps her waist clear of it.

scene: EXT. NIGHT STREET AND SMALL HOME GATE — NIGHT
direction: Baribari slips backward; Saurabh catches her immediately in a protective hold.

scene: INT. BARIBARI’S HOME AND SAURABH’S BEDROOM — NIGHT / MORNING
direction: Saurabh carries Baribari safely through the gate and into her home.

scene: INT. BARIBARI’S HOME AND SAURABH’S BEDROOM — NIGHT / MORNING
direction: He calls her family and explains exactly that she became unconscious on their walk home and he carried her through the narrow gate.

scene: INT. BARIBARI’S HOME AND SAURABH’S BEDROOM — NIGHT / MORNING
direction: He watches with concern, feeling he never wants to lose her and wants a life with her.

scene: INT. BARIBARI’S HOME AND SAURABH’S BEDROOM — NIGHT / MORNING
direction: A bright flare transitions from night to pale morning light in Saurabh’s real bedroom.

scene: INT. BARIBARI’S HOME AND SAURABH’S BEDROOM — NIGHT / MORNING
direction: Saurabh wakes abruptly; he remembers “Baribari” but cannot recall her surname. Fade to black.
